# Assessment Overview

Supplementary documents for the `eShopLegacyMVCSolution` assessment.
- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) — High-level application architecture and component relationships.

- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) — Database configuration, entity relationships, persistence ownership, and data sensitivity.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) — Configuration sources, runtime/build profiles, properties, and secret handling.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) — Catalog domain concepts, user workflows, and business rules.
